name: New Year Gift
description: How to warm the heart of every grumpy tanker? With a holiday gift and a newly wrapped tank under the tree! The paint is designed for New Year 2018 celebrations.
interestingFacts: This paint was available in the Shop as part of a special bundle during the New Year 2018 celebrations from December 24, 2017, to January 8, 2018.

As you might expect, the primary ingredient in this paint is wrapping paper. Other ingredients include cheeriness, nostalgia for years past, and a creeping dread that year by year your life is coming closer to ending without leaving a meaningful mark on the world. Neat!
